notes.title: MVK 1.0.61 Patch notes: Prism-A Tower mini update.
notes.content:
MECHS V KAIJUS v1.0.61 PATCH NOTES.

Hello Commanders!
 
We improve a lot the Prism-A Tower since they were not up to the task of being one of the most powerful towers in the game.

But with that improvement, plus the 100% return on sells, we found a heavy exploit, that will break the game. 
Because of that we are introducing a big, but no so big change. A -5% change or tax, hehe, on the "SELL" of the structures, this very small percentage should not affect the replace wall mechanic since it´s only $8 less (150 - 142, for walls), but should put a break in an exploit that I found while playing with the new Prism-A Towers. Since they are the most expensive they will sell for 1900 of 2000.

Remember the idea of the 100% returns of the first tier was always to encourage experimentation and fast adaptability to each wave in the early game, or reposition a tower if the placement was not good. 


HOT FIXES:

Titan Hunters & Sky Battle levels will have an anti-lock soft that will win the level after the final wave, the timer has to reach zero, plus the number of kaiju alive is the same for over 10 seconds. If the number of kaiju alive changes the counter will reset. 
This was the same fail-safe added to the Park level and looks like it works ok. 

Mechalibur and Kappa suddenly have -10% life random at the end of the level.


ODIN BULLETS (fix): 
Odin Bullets discrepancy in fire rate and magazine size, when switched them in battle vs selected them in Odin's upgrades menu, this last was the correct one. 

About the Ammo, since some of you guys asked in the discord:

Long Range bullets are the standard, have the longest reach, highest DPS (550 without upgrades), and biggest magazine. But they do single-target damage. 

Explosive Bullets are like grenade launchers. They do area of damage on impact, which is especially useful when a lot of small and medium kaijus clump up. Good very good for the small levels with medium to low tier kaiju. 

Armour-Piercing: The OP bullet, that is why is very late on the tech tree. It does 300 DPS, but does damage in a straight line and can pass thru Kaijus, excellent to reach the range kaijus. 

Explosive and AP bullets have a decreased rate of fire and range if compared with the standard bullets and limited magazine. By the time players which to this ammo they need to be comfortable with leaving the main wall and go closer to the kaijus. 


IMPROVEMENTS:

The tutorial now teaches the players to jump the mechs out of the wall to reach the enemies that are far away. 

Mechs Flares:
Now they said Mechs Landing Spot for 5 seconds at the beginning of the level so there is no doubt what they are for. 

Better Prism-A Towers:

Better sound and visual effects.
Fixed a bug where they cut the shoot, doing less damage than they should. 
New: Now the tower will follow the mouse when selected, and since the shoot is longer if timed wright can be used to swipe enemies. 


CHANGES IN LEVELS:
SkyWorld Plaza, the Kaiju Boss Nematodah Rex will spawn 3 Kaiju spawners at the beginning, we feel the first 3 to 4 first minutes of the mission needs a little more action. 

Added more landing spots in the early levels so players get more comfortable with this mechanic since is critical for episode II, and will reduce the need to upgrade the mechs upgrade a bit. 

I hope that you guys like these changes. Please let us know how they feel after testing it.

notes.title: POST LAUNCH PATCH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/38c169532afccd684c96c05f90119462b513cc58.jpg[/img]

Hello Commanders!

We launch! But we also did have a bumpy release, lots of ups and downs, to say the least. A lot of bug fixing in the last two days on our part, and some bad experiences for you guys. We apologize for it, more testing before the release was in place. Rest assured that we are working full time, all game-breaking bugs are fixed, and we will deal with others if appears. 


A more complex issue is the difficulty level of the game for a lot of new players, especially at the beginning. Enough that some changes are needed so everyone can enjoy the game, a challenge, but also have fun. 

These next changes are in good heart, they will ease the early part of the game. Especially true for Easy difficulty (+HQ Armor) and for Normal. Grind is not a core idea here, just a resource if needed. 

Easing the learning curve for the people that like a more passive or hands-off tower defenses game, is important. Not all are fans of RTS games like Starcraft, WarCraft, Age of Empires, for those, hard is still hard!

Also, not everybody knows the Defcon nomenclature, and some players have picked hard instead of easy, so we are going back to the naming standard. 

For all the hardcore RTS players, that really like the game as it is, the HARD ex Defcon 1, and HARDCORE will remain the same in terms of buffers/nerf. These are for those that are looking for a more challenging experience. HARDCORE will appear in the game after beating the came, and can be accessed only by the new game. 


We will roll them now, version 1.45, the change in tech prices is already up.
Try them on Sunday, and see what is the feedback from all the spectrum of players. 


[b]HIGHER IMPACT CHANGES: [/b]

[b]Easy Difficulty: [/b]
+60% Armor Bonus to the Main Wall. 
This will give players more critical time to react before the shields HQ go down to cero and start taking damage. Also, the HQ hit points will be able to tank more pressure for the Kaiju, reducing a lot the sudden deaths, especially in the early levels where kaijus do less damage. Shields recharging time will stay the same. 

-25% Hitpoints for the KaijuOverall difficult reduction.

[b]Normal Difficulty: [/b]
+20% Armor Bonus to the Main Wall. 
-7% Hitpoints for the Kaiju



[b]LOW IMPACT CHANGES[/b]

[b]New Game start resources[/b]
Tech from 350 to 550 points. 
Gold from 350 to 500.

Who doesn't want more tech and gold?

[b]Tech Tree: [/b]
Cheaper basic Early Tech and high light of crucial techs. 

Mechs Jetpack is unlocked from the start.
Anti Air tower from $200 to $100.
Tank Armor MK1 from $450 to $350
Tank Armor MK2 from $650 to $500
Missile Battery MK1 from $400 to 200
Missile Battery MK2 from $550 to 300
Grinders Mk1 from $400 to $300
Tank Factory from $600 to $500
Unlock Aegis Mech from $1100 to $750

F1 Key will toggle auto shoot for Odin ( not Auto Aim, that's your job pilot ;) ). 

[b]Factory Tanks[/b] will slow down 90% of the current speed for the attack, and they build up more over time. 

[b]Mechs Landing Spots:[/b]
Moving your Mechs forward is important when they have no Range Upgrades, which is one of the more important to assure constant damage output and no idle mechs. In mission 4, the mechs won't reach the Kaijus if they do not jump closer or have 2 Range upgrades. Flares that indicate a Mech landing position, we are adding a little arrow to be able to spot them more easily at the beginning. We are gonna add the Jetpack mechanic to the tutorial in the close future. 


[b]Level Changes:[/b]

M2 - Placid Lake: Spider waves rebalanced.
M7 - The Bridge: 5sec Warning before the node collapses. 1 less destructible node. 
M4 - Pokyo Households: 1 Building is destroyed and a construction node will be in its place to hint more clearly that controlled destruction can be beneficial sometimes. #collateralDamage.


We really hope that these changes will change for the better the overall experience for all players at the beginning and not the heart of the game. Try it and let us know your thoughts here or in discord. 

GL HF, and Good Hunting Commanders!

Nacho, aka Tenacious.

notes.title: WHERE IS THE NEW UPDATE?!
notes.content:
Hello Commanders! 

A quick update on where we are and why the last beta is not up already. 

Reason number one, we are adding controller support.
Witch is amazing, I know, hehe. But this is more easy said than done, is quite time-consuming since the game was not really intended to be played with controller, but we like the challenge. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/481ea072f8822565b66a0d29bb5492d8ea718311.png[/img]

But it's true that is taking quite longer than we thought. 
And, since we want your feedback on how the game feels with the controller before the release, we need to wait for this feature before the new beta is out. 

Another issue is our current GUI, the upgrade and sell nodes, were too small. And the GUI of the Mechs Jetpacks and Panacea Drones was not clear enough. But after implementing the Controller, such issues became impossible to ignore further.

So we are implementing a new Radial GUI for fast access for both controller and mouse. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/e8fb1bb85887539d529cb817b35b6cde78fe49ab.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/c5dcf109bd0a1babc0a4b0eef62350dc6d98cc97.png[/img]


The Armory Menu barely works on the keyboard, never like that grid to be honest. But with controller wast pretty bad, so we create a new GUI for the Armory menu + (New Ability): [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/dee6418de686a1a3ba5530e217ff7cbb257b05ac.png[/img]

But this needs to be changed in every single level by hand, and the game has over 60 levels in total. This happens a lot in this game because. This is one of the main reasons why takes a long time to upgrade or change something in-game.
This is because the game was created in unity 5.6 and at that time the prefabs were pretty basic and I was a noob at coding!

I think and hope, that we will finish these 2 features in less than 15 days. And with that, we will publish a beta for you guys to check out. 

The Final tech tree won't be in that release. That is for the 1.0! :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/45bab2320e54734867fce37fd8064bef7fe356fe.png[/img]

Thank you all for your patience, the game is getting better than ever with many annoying bugs fixed, a more responsive GUI, and changes in the quality of life in-game. I'm very excited to show you guys the work so far, I will keep you posted where on any development!

GG WP!

notes.title: INCOMING NEWS.
notes.content:
[h2]Hello commanders![/h2]

The Game Developers Conference has just ended and I was lucky to be able to attend this year. Although it was online and it is not the same, it was what I needed to recharge my batteries and my passion for making games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/6ab461b7904f6028f3bc89725f5dfa9f7fc018a7.gif[/img]

The development of MVK has been on hold for a few months, since to launch the game, I need to solve some important bugs that the truth after months of trying I have not been able to. Those who have been since the beginning know that I learned to program with this game so there are parts of the code that need to be rewritten from scratch by someone with much more knowledge than me.

To achieve this, my idea is to launch a very small game of commemorative NFTs for the game and use the winnings to finish MVK. Some of these NFT's may be used in the next Double Punch games, unlocking content or unique units!! Plus the soundtrack as DLC.  (The soundtrack is free on Iaio Spotify). 

If we succeed expect the release of MVK in Q4 this year. 

In my opinion, the world of gaming and cryptocurrencies is the future. Those players can be actual owners of the content, can trade with others outside of the game ecosystem, unlock a unit in one game and use it in a different game is crazy but it is not. All proceeds will go to the fund to finish MVK.

Please tell me if this is something that you guys are interested in. I have been researching and I really believe that it is the future. I believe that players benefit from the wealth that a game and/or gaming ecosystem can generate in the future of gaming. That is why we have been talking with the people of ENJIN to integrate them into our next projects.

For example, those who get Odin's NFT will be able to unlock it and use it in our next game: Titans League! A fast PVP BattleMechs arena with tower defense. If you liked MVK, I think you will like TL.

More news on this game and the commemorative NFT sale coming soon, and a demo of TL for everyone to try and give us feedback.

The idea of the armory is to make the experience more entertaining, being able to have an "Extra Punch, perhaps a Doble Punch ;D" at key moments to destroy an enemy or survive a level. 

Perhaps some of the powers are too strong and will be rebalanced later.

Thank you very much for your support and patience Comandantes! It has been a difficult but beautiful road to make this game. I hope that MVK will be the kickoff for many more games from my Double Punch studio.

After the update, I will be bringing you news of the release date, in which a few new special operations and survival levels will be added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/bc63ea72ef65bf212d2ae470e13ae6da527ed2a4.jpg[/img]

Revisited Pokyo Households.  [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/821c50e7361545cb7e03dd802faeff59988dcea1.jpg[/img]

T.R.O.S. deployed a prototype SAN-SITE to aid the evacuation. 
ONE sends 2 upgraded Maus Tanks. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32155727/d27ccf65382223d267bb5e14904350e24126b2f7.jpg[/img]

[b]Fase one of the competitive Mechs V Kaijus has started. 

The Survival levels and special Time Challenge is available to show who is the boss! 

After release will be more complex Time Challenges and a Speed-Run update that will add the option to have a CALL WAVE BUTTON. Time to show that APM![/b]

notes.title: THE MECHS UPDATE!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello Commanders! [/h1][/b]
This update will be live next Wednesday!  The update brings 3 new mechs to the MVK Universe, a new more powerful weapons system for Odin, a new tower, mechanics, and more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/0753106d13aa0695d6ed015904898c5fd26aba44.gif[/img]

As the battle continues more countries join the fight for the defense of Pokio. 

[h1][b]From England: [/b]Edgar with Mechalibur,[/h1] a specialized Anti Air mech from the Royal Air Force. 
Biggest range mech (165 points),   4.500 Hit Points of Health. Can only attack air!


[h1][b]From Japan: [/b]Kenshi brings Aegis the Titan Hunter.[/h1] High DPS single target Mech, brings a huge shield giving it 7.500 Hit Points of Health and the strength to withstand the kaiju bullets and direct attacks.


[h1][b]From China: [/b]Liam with Geminis,[/h1] dual welding magnesium blades Kaiju killing machine. Geminis it's a melee Mechs trading range for insane damage. Works best off the main wall and in the battlefield. 6.500 Hit Points of Health. 

[h1][b]Health and Armor:[/b][/h1]

All the Mechs have hitpoints now and can be damaged and destroyed by the Kaijus. Commanders should keep the mechs in the best state possible by doing repairs in the Repair Bay menu.  In extreme cases, mechs can go into battle with no health, but they will be jumping back to the carrier if damage and left the battlefield. The Main wall will protect for most parts, the mechs. But they can take a reduced amount of damage there. 

Repairs cost gold if you don't have any gold to make repair now can outsource some tech in exchange for gold. 

[b]If Odin is destroyed you will lose the battle!

If you continue the previous game you will probably have to repair the mechs the first time you load the game after the update.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6ab461b7904f6028f3bc89725f5dfa9f7fc018a7.gif[/img]

[h1][b]NEW TOWER & MECHANIC:[/b][/h1]

[h1]MECHS JETPACKS: [/h1]New ability that enables the re-position of the mechs out of the main wall into special drop positions on the maps. Possible drop spots are marked with a red flare on the ground.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/fcd97bdcec7dcf4e4338992469f24882c25f38b8.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/a62276dc2233d4c8a58beb70366eb61d54dc86a2.jpg[/img]

[h1]MECH PLATFORM TOWER:[/h1]
Late game tower: creates a drop spot for the mechs. Now new trench tactics and objectives are possible. Also provides some kind of protection to the mechs, if the platform is destroyed the mech will go back to the Base Wall.

The true power of this mechanic will be exploited in Episode 2, but they will offer a new way to play Episode 1 too. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/18cb7e0242a3394a32ff605c6fd27cc88b2a0405.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6ab461b7904f6028f3bc89725f5dfa9f7fc018a7.gif[/img]

[h1][b]ODIN WEAPON SYSTEM[/b][/h1]

Odin just got upgraded! The new OWS uses now Gold to buy the upgrades, unifying all type of mechs upgrades with this currency.
This update adds 3 types of ammo that are unlockables at the tech tree. Once unlocked you can choose what ammo is the best for what mission. Also later in the tech tree, you can unlock the Odins Auto Loader tech, that let you swap ammo in-game pressing Tab (Key).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/68952bb3fc03781bf0b7c2ca32dcc2ff3f33facc.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]ODIN NEW AMMO & MORE:[/b][/h1]

[b]Long Range: [/b]
550 Damage per bullet (High DPS) single target bullet. Has the most reach in game, and more damage per bullet, huge magazine.

[b]Explosive Ammo: [/b]
350 Damage per bullet (Medium DPS) explodes on contact, causing medium damage in a radius. Medium reach, big magazine. Very effective if the Kaijus pile up against the walls.

[b]Armor Piercing Ammo: [/b]
200 Damage per bullet (Low-Medium DPS), The Bullets are small and dense enough to pass through all the Kaijus, Low-Medium reach. Rapid Fire, medium size magazine. Best option to reach through the Kaijus, epic damage if they line up!

[b]Seek Missiles: [/b]
Odin rocket pods are finally online and now shoots rockets every 10 seconds.  You can choose between Anti Land and Anti Air (unlockable) missiles.

[b]Armor and Shield: [/b]
Odin has 10.000 Hit Points of Health and up to 1.500 Shield Points. Armor reduces the damage taken up to 65% less damage.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6ab461b7904f6028f3bc89725f5dfa9f7fc018a7.gif[/img]

[h1][b]TUTORIALS:[/b][/h1]
The game will have a mini pop-ups tutorials in the tech tree for the more complex things in the game. Like the Prism-A and the Mech Platform tower, jump ability. If you commanders feel that other tutorials are needed please make your suggestion in the discord channel (Dev Talk). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/800cdc5f80761d2a4e480a25ca0c5d3a39d65475.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]AUTOSAVE:[/b][/h1] 
"Hell, it´s about time..."  Now every time you go back to the War room the game will save. 

[b][h1]New Languages:[/h1][/b] 
English got a massive correction in grammar.
French and Spanish are added and very close to get them 100%.
Other Languages are in work in progress, if you want to help me translate the game to your language please join our discord and let me know. I'm always there.

[h1][b]BUGS[/b][/h1]
Nodes selections complete fix. Now, no matter how many Kaijus are on top of a construction node you will be able to select them with no problem. Finally!

The second biggest problem is also fixed the miss-click Sell-Upgrade. Now when selecting a tower a quick animation will make appear the upgrade and sell button, making impossible to sell a tower when selecting the nearby tower. It´s still not perfect but it's getting there.

Tanks getting stucks in walls.

Audio setup now saves from one play to the next.
Almost all sound in the Audio Manager, some sounds are missing, so if you mute the game probably one or two sound are gonna still be heard. I'm trying to catch them all!

No more slow win or game over screen. 

And much much more. 

[h1][b]BALANCE:[/b][/h1]
Rougton are faster
Dalifantes are Faster.

notes.title: The Towers Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/d657583387139b5676cbb8fe2599b6b7923ca170.jpg[/img]

Tomorrow, August 30 the largest content update of Mechs V Kaijus to date will be live! I’m very proud of this one, I think it brings a lot of new things to the game making it more interesting and fixing many reported issues. ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6c03238835f1fd7a03af59c99f49cd6a6ca829ed.gif[/img]

This update includes:

5 New Towers: 

Prism-A Tower: (Destructible: Mk1: 1000HP - Mk2: 1550HP - Mk3: 2500HP - Shield Upgrade)
A Ray tower with devastating power, and the biggest area of damage in the game. This tower could be the most powerful or the most useless. It's a tricky tower to use. It is the first tower that must be pointed manually to get the most out of it. An example is to place it in the lowest part of the map pointing to the line of walls, this way you can attack the entire line of defense.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6f35a03b24979245ac22820ec745423901b94004.jpg[/img]


The Flamethrower: (Destructible:  Mk1: 750HP - Mk2: 1000HP - Mk3: 1500HP - No shield)
If the Grinder works better in front of a wall the Flamethrower does it behind it. It has a greater damage area than the grinder and more damage, but it does not slow down the Kaijus.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/fc93b8caed44f8d7065cbfb84e83a7d4f8611e99.jpg[/img]


The Tank Factory: (Destructible:  Mk1: 500HP - Mk2: 750HP - Mk3: 950HP - No shield)
This construction introduces a new mechanics to the world of MKV: the production of units. The tank factory Mk2 and Mk3 produces the most powerful new tanks: The Maus Tank from Germany and the Armageddon Tank from Russia, this last one armed with dual cannons and anti air rockets. This factory is very weak and must be protected from the kaiju attacks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/7984865fef15e3f65512bb75a2fdb40204a40c90.jpg[/img]


Artillery: (Destructible:  Mk1: 450HP - Mk2: 750HP - Mk3: 1000HP - No shield)
The artillery is the tower with the greatest range to date, specially the Mark 3, and great destructive power. It can only attack forward and within an area. You can not attack kaijus who are too close, so it is recommended to put them in the last line of defense. It is not very precise, it has problems with the very fast Kaijus, but if they are stopped by a wall they are doomed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/56ea17df1817acb037378c6cc872b4b163a13948.jpg[/img]


Sam Site:  (Destructible:  Mk1: 1000HP - Mk2: 1500HP - Mk3: 2000HP - Shield Upgrade)
The sam site has a much greater reach than the anti-air tower. Shoot 2 to 4 guided missiles with devastating damage and an even greater damage area. Designed to kill large enemy formations and Category 4 Flying Kaijus, it struggles to hit small fast targets.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/a1a7216a6d423f175904938f3390a5e04d3c2e39.jpg[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6c03238835f1fd7a03af59c99f49cd6a6ca829ed.gif[/img]


The Special Ops: 

The Salvo Hotel: (Difficulty level: 3/10)

First Special Ops, 15 waves of enemies will try to destroy the Salvo Hotel. The low amount of building nodes for the towers in this one makes imperative that you choose wisely and keep an eye on the upgrades. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/dd3467e8c9c82ca0f0cd2a8ad2d804d158311e2b.jpg[/img]


The Customs Office: (Difficulty level: 4/10)

This mission is designed to accustom the commander in the fight against the flying Kaijus, before the very difficult mission of Pokio HouseHolds. It has a good amount of construction nodes with a clear line for the walls.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/5bedf92cd3f2a6cb49768f0776b28c82e0e4e301.jpg[/img]


The Park: (Difficulty level: 4.5/10)

The Central Park is the first screen in Horde mode outside of the challenges. Here the kaijus do not come by waves, but the different types of kaijus come all mixed in waves that merge with each other making an infinite stream of kaijus.
It is a good practice before the Battle of Pokio Plaza, which functions in the same modality.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/584c97b84112ef221f7128cfb2182a911df1e89d.jpg[/img]


Line of Defence: (Difficulty level: 6/10)

In line of Defense we must defend a UN tank factory where Russia is finishing developing the Armageddon Tank, which the player can use later in the campaign once unlocked.
This map will be almost a trench war where you will have to fight for every centimeter (or inch). This special operation also has the extended battlefield, where the commander will be able to pan the camera to expand his vision of the battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/72ef9eb83e6190db84046b26b26c833dc57889d7.jpg[/img]


Island Jump: (Difficulty level: 8.5/10)

This is probably the strangest map of MVK, few places to build distributed on small islands with a central road very difficult to defend since all the land kaijus concentrated on this point. A great challenge only for the best commanders.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/23fcb95fa00abf5bf30f8d0143c5595602cfe124.jpg[/img]


Enter WestWood: (Difficulty level: 8/10)

This battle unfolds north of Westwood Island already taken by the Kaijus. It is a great battlefield where we will have a lot of space to build and use the new towers with greater reach. This is where we will find the full power of the kaijus.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/68fd2bf47c762f5f9f3ac674800565254067365a.jpg[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6c03238835f1fd7a03af59c99f49cd6a6ca829ed.gif[/img]

Improvements: 

This update brings not so conventional towers as the artillery or the Prism-a tower, for this and at the request of the players we could not delay the displayed range and area of attack of the towers.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/5ec5ddf512023df030c338b4efb2ce9fc08d9415.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/11af055cb5c7d61b6dfdca1775092ad794fe04b3.jpg[/img]


Also all the new towers tier 2 are destructible like the walls. For this reason we have changed the graphic of the life bars to make them more visible and differentiate them better from the bars of the Kaijus.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/61cead5a99aae07803a8fa6b4d6fe1f07dababc3.jpg[/img]

There is again the option to change the difficulty in the OPTIONS menu!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6c03238835f1fd7a03af59c99f49cd6a6ca829ed.gif[/img]

BREAK GAME BUGS FIX! 

Finally we found the line of code that could block the upgrades of the mechs and we have corrected it! 
We also fixed a bug that occasionally resets the unlock of missions when an update is made.

Maybe some will lose the Odin upgrades in the update, last time. This can happen through the update of the save system.

Fixed a bug that erased some waves of missions, this happens more critically in the Titan challenges, making that sometimes they did not appear. Now they are working correctly.

SMALL BUGS FIX! 

This is just too long and boring to put it here! hehehe… If you guys and girls wanna find out about the small changes please let me know and i will do another post. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32155727/6c03238835f1fd7a03af59c99f49cd6a6ca829ed.gif[/img]

THE FUTURE OF MVK: 

After this update I feel more confident about the game, without break game problems and also that there is enough content to sit down and finish writing episode 2, something everyone is asking for.

Maybe there are some minor updates with problem solutions if there is any, or a new mission, but now I will put the attention in 3 things. The realization of the episode The Kaiju Wars, and the new Mercenaries Mechs and Odin's new custom weapon system.

These are the features most requested by you in the player survey made a few months ago and I intend to deliver them all. I want to make Mechs V Kaijus one of the best Tower Defense Game that has been made, so it takes me more time than I thought. I am very grateful to all the fans that have approached Discord to report bugs, give feedback and always support with the best attitude.

Thank you all for your support. 

Nacho Mancebo, Doble Punch Games.
